_note: What a companion is made of, rolled once when she is first given (Companions.roll, seeded by her player's id, so the same player gets the same roll), and kept in her record. One call to the voice model then writes her card, a paragraph, from these, and one sentence of how she and her player met (decision 293). Each entry is a few plain words, never prose or a line to say. 'trade' in a profession is the trade she works in a town she stays in (decision 284; one of levels/economy.json's, or empty for none). In how_we_met, {player} is her player's name and {pronoun} her own. Lore will supply birthplaces and names per region once facts are agreed.

growth._note: Her card grows (decision 294): at most facts_max facts about her (over it, the oldest of what she witnessed is merged into a short history) and beliefs_max beliefs about the world (the oldest dropped); her voice is told them within prompt_chars characters, her newest event_facts_shown witnessed facts among them; what was said with her player is read for new facts once a stretch of at least talk_lines lines of theirs has been quiet for quiet_seconds.

guide._note: Her guiding (decision 551): she leads her player to a place or area she has been with them (record.companion roads), on the world's routes, waiting while they are more than wait cells behind; there within arrive cells of it; a stopped walk is taken up again by 'lead on' within keep_minutes; her voice is told the nearest places_told places she knows the way to; it stops when her player falls under hurt_below of their hp. What she lived through somewhere is kept as a danger of that area with its weight (weights; 'hurt' when a blow leaves her or her player under hurt_mark of their hp), the heaviest a day per area and kind; the refusal by weight comes in phase 2. What she hears of the roads (551 phase 2, npc's side, RoadKnowledge): a wagon struck by a camp is a heard danger of the camp's area at heard_weights; a danger weighs its whole for fresh_days of its kind, then straight down to nothing at twice that; a camp nobody holds drops its heard dangers, and a passage through an area without a stop halves that area's dangers once a day. Her refusal (551 phase 2, companions'): asked, she will not walk a road whose dangers (their faded weights on its areas) reach her nerve: boldness by her temperament (boldness_default for one not listed), plus bond by her Standing word with her player, plus company for each other player beside them; she names the worst, offers to go as far as the last place short of them, and refuses the same goal the rest of the day; drafts for Jeff.

bond._note: Her bond with her player (decision 444, on npc's Standing, 443): what each of their deeds moves it by, drafts for Jeff. Standing's COMPANION ladder: fond to start, wary at -3, close at 3, devoted at 6 (residents.json 'standing'). A day together counts only up to close: devotion is earned by deeds.

legacy._note: Companions from before the roll, kept (Jeff): a companion with one of these names keeps it, and her 'fixed' facts are seeds the roll keeps, the rest rolled round them; a new roll never gives the name. Keys of 'fixed' replace the rolled trait of that name; others ('who', 'aspiration', 'though': what stands against the aspiration) are added to what the card is written from. 'look' is her fixed look (decision 293 amended, for 419); 'leanings' her intellect and superstition (decision 442; drafts for Jeff). They rest in town between trips: when their player leaves the game they go to the town's stockpile and wait (decision 293).
